description: Producción de GLP por planta is a dataset listed in Argentine national open data portal (datos.gob.ar), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Energía. Detalle mensual del volumen y tipo de producto por planta productora. Coverage: Argentina. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Energía. Its tags are GLP, Hidrocarburos, Plantas de tratamiento de gas, Producción. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ar-portal.
